post.description:
Open a new ACTIVE conversation for the caller's tenant. A known
`customer_external_id` reuses that tenant's customer; otherwise one is created.

Run one support turn: Router -> knowledge -> specialist -> QualityAgent
(one retry on a low score) -> escalation policy. Escalating creates a ticket
and moves the conversation to ESCALATED; afterwards the bot no longer
answers (the message is stored for the human agent). A RESOLVED
conversation is reopened; a CLOSED one answers 409.

404.description: Not found (or owned by another tenant)

get.description:
The caller tenant's conversations, most recently updated first, optionally
filtered by status (active, resolved, escalated, closed). `limit` is capped at 200.

schema.title: Response List Conversations Api V1 Conversations Get

post.description:
Close as RESOLVED (`resolved: true`, the default) or CLOSED. Works from ACTIVE,
RESOLVED or ESCALATED (the human agent finishing the case); CLOSED is terminal: 409.

get.description:
Open (no token) for load balancers and post-deploy smoke tests: database
reachability, the LLM provider chain in order, the app version and, on Render,
the deployed git commit (RENDER_GIT_COMMIT).

Operational snapshot of the caller's tenant only: conversations by status and
resolution rate, messages, tickets, escalations, agent runs and errors, average
quality score, LLM usage per provider (calls, tokens, estimated USD cost) and
customer feedback.

post.description:
Register a company and issue its API key (48 hex chars, shown only in this
response). That key scopes every request to the tenant's own data.

Text to WAV with the configured engine (Kokoro on CPU by default; Chatterbox,
the cloned Kokoro or Cartesia degrade to Kokoro on failure). Cached on disk by
normalized text and voice.

get.description: Short filler texts the client prefetches and plays while the LLM thinks.

schema.title: Response List Fillers Api V1 Voice Fillers Get

get.description:
Voices for the active engine: Cartesia stock/cloned voices when the
cloud engine is on, otherwise the local OpenVoice references. Normalized
to {id, name} objects so the same panel drives both.

post.description:
Clone any voice from 10-60s of clean audio. In Cartesia mode it clones
in the cloud (cuasi-human, returns a voice id); in local mode it stores a
normalized WAV reference the OpenVoice converter embeds on first use.

One voice turn: audio -> Groq Whisper STT -> the same support workflow as a
text message -> spoken reply (base64 WAV). With `stream=true` the audio covers
only the first sentence and the rest come back as `remaining_sentences` for the
client to synthesize while it plays. Empty or untranscribable audio answers 422.
